Phase 71b implemented per the approved plan (docs/phases/safe-config-edits.md @ 3b496be) at 5a9649c, branch phase-71b-safe-config-edits. gate: see entry.

Where:
- tagteam/config_edit.py (new): SAFE_KEYS; saved() (absent|invalid|set) and effective() (the engine's resolvers); edit_text() (the narrow locator: replace the scalar keeping indent, spacing and trailing comment; insert after the header; append a block; refuse flow/scalar blocks, duplicates, block scalars and multi-line values, tabs, node-start anchors/aliases, document markers); plan() (locator FIRST, then a no-op on the saved value, then new == expected tree with only the target's parent normalised, then the honour check for enables and resend; a disable needs none); apply() (read-only refusal; writer_lock around read/--expect/plan/re-read/replace; guarded O_EXCL|O_NOFOLLOW write keeping the mode); config_command (keys / set --preview / --expect / --by).
- cli.py: dispatch, help, READ_ONLY_COMMANDS (keys and set --preview only).
- cockpit_api.py: _plan_config (strict JSON types; a write requires a 64-hex `expect`); config_preview (diff, base, engine, notes, and a CLI line with --expect); row `edits` [{key, kind, label, saved, saved_state, not_in_effect}].
- server.py: POST /api/config/set. cockpit.js/.css/.html: a "Phase 71b" slice (saved state in words plus a Turn on/off button, a minutes field) and a diff area in the confirm modal.
- Docs: README, how-tagteam-works, workflows Steering (data plus docs copy); phase doc implementation notes.

Verification:
- tests/test_config_edit.py (38): criterion 1 (exact line diffs, insert, append, CRLF with no trailing newline, the mode kept, parsed == old+target over several shapes × every key); 2 (every refusal with bytes unchanged; missing and symlinked files; read-only, with keys/--preview still allowed; compare-and-swap via the test hook; enables the engine would not honour, with the reason); 3 and 8 (a,b,c); 5 and 10 (--expect after an external edit); 9 (absent and empty blocks, unrelated empty block untouched); 11 (threads: B verified blocked, then both edits survive; processes: a child `tagteam config set` blocked on the flock while the parent holds the lock, then both edits survive); the backstop refuses a monkeypatched locator bug.
- tests/test_cockpit_rules.py (+ API: saved/not_in_effect rows, bad params as 400, preview → external edit → 409 with bytes unchanged → a fresh preview writes, a refused preview; + real Chromium: saved words and Turn on/off, the diff in the modal, one write POST carrying expect, no retry).
- Mutation checks: removing the lock fails both serialization tests; disabling the expected-tree check while planting a locator bug fails 4.
- Focused: config_edit, cockpit_rules, server_cockpit, cockpit_activity, readonly, docs_story, plugin, framework, config: 615 passed.
- Driven in a real page (phase doc): preview, a stale refusal with no retry, a successful write agreeing with `tagteam config keys`, and a refused resend.

Found by testing: the layout refusals initially ran after the no-op check (a duplicate or alias that parses to the requested value slipped through); the locator now always runs first.

Deviation: tab-indented YAML is refused as "does not parse" before the tab check.

GATE: PASS | scope 13 paths | plan-doc ok | tests ok (2449 passed, 5 skipped, 8m12s)
checked: HEAD 5a9649c

Reviewed 5a9649c against the approved plan. The shared writer lock, saved/effective separation in the engine, expected-tree backstop, strict endpoint types and preview digest checks are implemented. REQUEST_CHANGES for these reproduced gaps:

1. [P2] Refuse existing/duplicate target names expressed as quoted YAML keys (tagteam/config_edit.py:178-190 and keyline matching). The locator counts only unquoted spellings, while safe_load has already collapsed duplicate mapping keys. Starting with `"gatekeeper": {enabled: false}\n`, apply(gatekeeper.enabled, True) SUCCEEDS and appends a second unquoted gatekeeper block, bypassing both the flow-block refusal and the absent-block rule. A mixed quoted/unquoted duplicate block also succeeds, as does `gatekeeper:\n  "enabled": false\n  enabled: false\n`, which is rewritten with conflicting duplicate enabled definitions. The expected-tree check cannot detect this because parsing discarded the earlier duplicate. Inspect mapping node identities/occurrences before construction or otherwise detect unsupported spellings and duplicates; refuse them with the hand-edit message and unchanged bytes. Cover quoted-only target headers and mixed quoted/plain duplicate headers/leaves, including no-ops.

2. [P2] Allow explicitly setting OFF for an absent or invalid saved boolean (tagteam/data/web/cockpit.js:835-843). Every saved value other than true yields only a Turn on button. With briefer.enabled: "true" and agent names that cannot infer a provider, the payload correctly says invalid, but the ONLY UI action requests true and is refused because the briefer cannot run. The false preview succeeds through the API, yet the page cannot issue it. This prevents the planned recovery by persisting a real false and also requires an absent setting to be enabled before it can be explicitly disabled. Offer both explicit choices when saved_state is absent/invalid; test a click that sends false for an invalid boolean whose enable is refused, through preview and successful persistence.

3. [P2] Preserve the pending minutes edit across automatic refreshes (tagteam/data/web/cockpit.js:846-860). renderRules rebuilds the enforced rows on every SSE/live tick; renderEdits always seeds the new number input from the saved payload. Reproduced in real Chromium: render a saved interval of 15, enter 7 and focus the field, then renderRules with the unchanged payload => value is back to 15 and focus is lost. This repeats the advisory-input problem fixed in Phase 71 and can make Save use the old interval if a refresh lands before the click. Preserve the pending numeric text/focus across background updates, clearing/resetting it at the appropriate explicit completion/refusal boundary. Add a real-browser regression for refresh while editing.

4. [P2] Produce a valid, readable diff for the supported no-final-newline case (tagteam/config_edit.py:plan, unified_diff assembly). For `gatekeeper:\n  enabled: false` with no trailing newline, previewing true currently produces `-  enabled: false+  enabled: true` on ONE line. The CLI and confirmation therefore fail to show separate removed and added lines. Preserve the original file bytes, but render the diff with proper line separation and no-newline markers (or an equally explicit representation). Test the preview output for replacing the final scalar and appending to a file without a final newline; the existing byte-preservation test alone misses this.

Verification: accepted the recorded gate PASS at 5a9649c (2449 passed, 5 skipped; scope and plan-doc passed); no full-suite rerun. Focused tests/test_config_edit.py and tests/test_cockpit_rules.py: 95 passed. Additional isolated-project engine/API reproductions and a deterministic real-Chromium refresh reproduction established the findings above. No project config was edited. No arbiter interjections or advisory standing orders were present.

All four r1 findings are reproduced as tests and fixed (see the gate entry for the commit). gate: see entry.

1. [P2] Quoted/duplicate spellings. A new _node_lines() uses yaml.compose; its node tree keeps every key, with its quoting style and start line. A quoted block or leaf name is refused ("written as a quoted key — edit by hand"), as is a duplicated block or leaf (mixed quoted/plain included), a flow or non-mapping value, and an empty block counted from the node. The text locator's header and key lines must equal the parser's lines, else "laid out in a way tagteam does not edit". Tests: TestQuotedAndDuplicateSpellings, 7 texts (your three reproductions plus quoted-only header/leaf and plain-then-quoted) × {True, False}; the False cases are the no-op spellings. All refused with bytes unchanged. Disabling the node check fails 14.

2. [P2] Explicit OFF. A SET boolean toggles (Turn on/Turn off); an ABSENT or INVALID one offers both Set on and Set off. Real-Chromium test: briefer.enabled invalid, enable preview refused → the Set off click sends {value:false, preview:true}, then the confirmed write with expect. API test: an invalid "true" with no provider → the enable is refused → the false preview and the write persist a real false.

3. [P2] Pending minutes. RULES_EDIT.pending[key] is updated on input and used by renderEdits in place of the saved value. It is cleared at the explicit boundaries (write done, refusal, no-op). Focus is captured before the rows are rebuilt and restored after they are attached. Real-Chromium regression: saved 15, type 7 with focus, renderRules → still 7 and focused; Save sends 7; after the refusal it's back to 15. Removing the pending restore fails it.

4. [P2] The diff without a final newline. render_diff() diffs lines without their endings and appends git's "\ No newline at end of file" to the final line when it lacks one, so a changed last line shows as separate -/+ lines. Tests: replacing the final scalar (two markers, separate lines), appending to a file with no newline, and no marker for an ordinary file. File bytes are unchanged, as before.

Focused: test_config_edit + test_cockpit_rules: 115 passed.

GATE: PASS | scope 13 paths | plan-doc ok | tests ok (2469 passed, 5 skipped, 8m03s)
checked: HEAD f23224a

Approved at f23224a. Reviewed the revision against all four round-1 findings and the approved plan.

The locator now checks YAML mapping nodes before relying on textual matches, rejecting quoted/duplicate target spellings (including no-ops) and requiring the parser's source lines to match. Absent/invalid boolean controls offer explicit Set on and Set off actions, with API coverage for persisting false when enabling is refused. Pending minutes text and focus survive background row rebuilds and reset at explicit completion/refusal boundaries. Diff rendering separates removed/added final lines and includes no-final-newline markers without changing the edited file's newline behavior.

Verification: tests/test_config_edit.py and tests/test_cockpit_rules.py: 115 passed, including real-Chromium recovery and refresh regressions. Accepted the recorded gate PASS at the submitted HEAD f23224a (2469 passed, 5 skipped; scope and plan-doc passed); did not rerun the full suite. No remaining blocking findings. No arbiter interjections or advisory standing orders were present.
